newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Woman burns herself and child to death in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Woman burns herself and child to death in Vietnam.

text.p: A pregnant woman died after setting herself ablaze in Vietnam's central province of Nghe An, the Lao Dong newspaper said on Friday.
Local authorities were not available to confirm the report, which said the woman had also poured petrol on the two children of a family that employed her as a servant and set light to them.
The two children survived, but one of them, a girl, was still being treated in hospital. The incident took place on January 1.
The newspaper said it was thought that the woman had killed herself because the family refused to take responsiblility for her future child.
There are several reports of self-immolation in Vietnam every year.
